description: Identifies the Google user connected to Calendar from the primary calendar resource. Returns the account identifier, email when available, display name, timezone, and primary calendar ID. This is Calendar identity metadata, not a full Google Account or People profile.
name: get_current_user

account_id.description: Identifier of the connected Calendar principal, taken from the primary calendar ID. For a user account this is normally the account email address.
account_id.title: Account Id

display_name.description: Display name of the connected user's primary calendar.
display_name.title: Display Name

email.description: Connected user's email address when the primary calendar ID has email form.
email.title: Email

primary_calendar_id.description: Identifier of the connected principal's primary calendar.
primary_calendar_id.title: Primary Calendar Id

time_zone.description: IANA timezone configured for the connected user's primary calendar.
time_zone.title: Time Zone
